label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 18-under after opening rounds of 64 and 60, holding a four-shot lead over Jackson Suber (-14) as Saturday's third round begins at TPC Craig Ranch.

items.headline: Im's Hole-in-One
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th hole and eagled the par-5 9th in a second-round 61, climbing to 13-under and sharing the 36-hole lead at the CJ CUP Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Spieth’s Birdie Run
items.text: Jordan Spieth shot a bogey-free 62 highlighted by six consecutive birdies on the back nine, moving to 12-under but sitting six shots behind leader Si Woo Kim.
